notes.title: A freshly brewed adventure awaits during Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hello, fellow bartenders! ☕️🌌

Get ready to brew up some fast-paced strategy! Super Barista, the unique coffee shop management and tower defense hybrid, [b]now has a free demo available on Steam[/b], just in time for Steam Next Fest, starting today.

Step into the shoes of an intergalactic barista, serving caffeine-fueled customers while fending off waves of alien invaders. [b]With a blend of deep strategy, charming pixel art, and frantic gameplay, Super Barista is a fresh take on the genre that will challenge both your multitasking and tactical skills[/b]. Don’t miss your chance to try Super Barista for free during Steam Next Fest! Play the demo now and see if you have what it takes to become the ultimate space-faring coffee master.

notes.title: Become a cosmic bartender in Super Barista! Officially Brewing in 2025!
notes.content:
Hello, fellow bartenders! ☕️🌌

[b]Prepare to embark on a caffeinated cosmic journey like no other in Super Barista![/b] This brand-new PC game is brewing up an adventure, set to launch in 2025 on Steam and the Epic Games Store!
In Super Barista, you’ll be serving up delicious coffee shots to a galaxy of quirky customers in a fast-paced blend of tower defense and matchmaking gameplay. Fancy a sneak peek? [b]You can get an exclusive taste of the action by trying out the playable demo during the Steam Next Fest![/b]

You’ll be dishing out espresso, macchiatos, and lattes to a wild variety of clients, from humans to exotic beings like Murgaks, Gleethe, and Antenoids! Your mission: match their caffeine cravings perfectly and serve them before they zoom away on the conveyor belt. It’s all about product matching, real-time strategy, and casual tower defense mechanics, with a dash of speed and creativity to keep the galaxy’s coffee supply in check! 🪐

[previewyoutube=VxNfwfK8O9I;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Wishlist Super Barista now![/i]

What’s on the menu? Here’s a sip of what you can expect:

[h3]GAME FEATURES[/h3]

✨ Cosmic Coffee Delivery – Travel across five unique planets, each packed with challenging levels and quirky customers that will put your barista skills to the ultimate test.
⚡ Dynamic Gameplay – Manage multiple coffee drones, hire crew members with special abilities, and serve your customers with precision and flair in this fast-paced coffee showdown.
💥 Hyper Speed Modes – Unlock crazy, extra-rewarding Hyper Speed Modes that will push your skills to the limit, adding new layers of excitement to each level.
👽 Unique Clientele – From intergalactic VIPs to regular space travelers, each with special caffeine needs, get ready to handle unpredictable space events that will challenge your barista abilities!
🎮 Collectibles – Collect 200 unique cards featuring characters designed by pixel artists from across the globe, including legends like Henrik Pettersson, eBoy, and Tim Soret.

So, mark your calendars, fellow baristas, for the 2025 launch of Super Barista and prepare for a space-filled adventure that’s sure to keep you on your toes—and your coffee shots perfectly brewed! ☕✨ Don’t forget to play the demo during Steam Next Fest for an early taste of the action.

See you behind the counter, heroes of the cosmic coffee shop! 💫
